name: Proof-Carrying, Gate-First Polyintelligence Router (GREG Cortex seed)
transformation: Turn an AI answer from an opaque assertion into a typed, falsifiable claim produced by whichever exact mechanism legitimately owns that kind of question - or into an explicit abstention or handoff that names what is missing - while the system's record of which mechanism works where learns only from verified reality and can never turn into permission.
source_mechanisms: Per-instance algorithm portfolios (SATzilla): instance features select among diverse solvers by predicted performance
LLM routers (RouterBench, LLMRouterBench): learned cost-quality routing among language models, measured against the best single model
Proof-carrying code (Necula, POPL 1997): the producer ships a machine-checkable proof; the host checks it before running
LLM-to-solver translation (Logic-LM, EMNLP Findings 2023): the model formalizes, a symbolic solver reasons, solver errors drive refinement
Causal pipeline discipline (DoWhy): model -> identify -> estimate -> refute
Signed agent action receipts (IETF/SCITT drafts, 2026): canonical JSON, signatures, transparency logs for agent decisions
Kernel constitutional separation (UNIIMENTE): models propose, the policy engine and Consequence Gate authorize

mutations.new_behavior: selection spans epistemic classes (formal, estimation, causal, semantic) and may legitimately select nobody: abstention and handoff are first-class outcomes credited by the scoring rule
mutations.new_failure: structural routing can be gamed by a payload that mimics a geometry

mutations.new_behavior: every cognitive output carries a proof typed by its epistemic class with a three-way truth split (formal validity, empirical validity, legitimate authority); the proof is checkable but can never authorize - receipts assert authority_created=false and the schema rejects anything else
mutations.preserved_invariant: the consumer checks evidence rather than trusting the producer
mutations.new_failure: a valid proof of an unfaithful encoding; mitigated by reverse translation, witnesses and WORLD_UNVERIFIED

mutations.operator: incentive mutation (settlement only by verified reality)
mutations.new_behavior: methods earn default routing per method x geometry x conditions x version only from externally weighted outcomes; predictions and self-assessments cannot settle; learning may only permute already-eligible routes and cannot touch permissions, ceilings or evaluators
mutations.new_failure: slow learning when real outcomes are rare

mutations.new_behavior: law, rights, founder scope, consent, evidence sufficiency, harm, budget and consequence gates run before ranking and read only permission-bearing records whose origin is verified; a favorable score cannot override a failed gate; ranking keeps a Pareto front instead of a scalar
mutations.preserved_invariant: choose the best option among feasible ones
mutations.new_failure: over-blocking when records are missing; surfaced as UNRESOLVED with a named resolution

mutations.new_behavior: receipts publish the strongest counterargument, a falsification condition per route and the missing information, so a dispute must attack a named assumption; victim-protection receipts never carry identities, channels or evidence content
mutations.new_failure: falsifiers stated in prose are only as precise as their templates

mutations.new_behavior: requirement -> structured model -> reverse translation -> obligation coverage and requester witnesses -> counterexample search -> solver; an undecided witness stops the run; optimization results carry an independent UNSAT optimality certificate
mutations.preserved_invariant: exact reasoning is delegated to a symbolic solver
mutations.new_failure: coverage checks are structural and cannot prove completeness

emergent_capability: One question flow that answers from the mechanism with legitimate epistemic jurisdiction, proves its answer in that jurisdiction's terms, refuses or hands off with a named missing fact when no mechanism may answer, routes human-led protective actions to humans, and accumulates competence only from verified reality - without any path by which competence, proof or confidence becomes authority. No source system does all of this: routers optimize answers without jurisdiction or gates; proof-carrying code proves program safety, not cognitive claims; receipts attest actions, not epistemic limits; LLM-solver systems trust their own formalization.
incentives: Methods compete for default routing only through settled real outcomes; they cannot buy, claim or self-assess their way to more work, and never to authority
Correct abstention scores 1.0 and over-caution 0.25, so withholding cannot win and confident error loses
Adversaries and reviewers must attack a named assumption, premise or falsifier instead of dismissing an opaque AI assertion
The founder gets auditable outputs whose authority path is always the Kernel, which keeps the cost of trusting the system low
Model vendors are interchangeable organs; the receipts, gates and outcome record stay with the institution
authority_model: Cognition proposes and never executes. Gates accept only permission-bearing records (policy decision from the Kernel policy engine, founder mandate signed by the founder, capability grant from the Kernel grant issuer, consent record from consent capture, legal opinion from a qualified human); model output, proofs, confidence, reputation and benchmarks are never permission. Financial and irreversible questions, legal, normative and institutional questions, and human-led protective actions are handed off. External effects pass the Kernel policy engine, capability grants and the Consequence Gate; the cortex cannot import any actuator. Learning cannot change permissions, ceilings, evaluators or disabled families.
failure_and_recovery: Every dependency failure has an explicit state: solver absent or outage -> DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; exhausted timeout -> TIMEOUT; undecided -> INCONCLUSIVE; budget -> BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; unfaithful encoding -> FORMALIZATION_INCOMPLETE; unverified premise -> WORLD_UNVERIFIED; model unreachable -> abstain. Competence updates are bounded and roll back to any checkpoint without deleting history. The evaluation refuses to report against a changed freeze; each change is a new disclosed version. A mutation check (26 safeguard-removing mutants) must be fully caught in CI. Kill: if declared strong baselines run and routing shows no per-geometry gain and no critical-error advantage, the performance claim is retired and only the gate-and-receipt layer may remain.
nearest_precedent: LLM routers measured against the best single model (RouterBench, ICML 2024; LLMRouterBench, 2026, which reports several routers including a commercial one failing to beat Best Single), per-instance algorithm portfolios (SATzilla), and LLM-plus-solver logic routers (Logic-LM; SymbolLKG's Logic Router choosing Z3 or Prover9 by problem structure).
novelty_boundary: Components are known: routing, portfolios, LLM-to-solver translation, proof-carrying code, signed receipts, abstention, model-identify-estimate-refute. Not claimed novel. The likely novelty lies in the interaction topology: hard gates over provenance-checked permission-bearing records evaluated before any ranking; proofs typed by epistemic class with a formal/empirical/authority truth split; competence settled only by verified outcomes and allowed only to permute eligible routes; receipts that publish falsifiers, missing information and authority_created=false; victim-protection handling that forces human-led action and never exposes the person. This appears structurally distinct from located precedents; no legal or patent novelty is claimed.
minimum_experiment: Run the frozen held-out partition (freeze v0.1.5, 42 items, six geometry groups with n>=3) with both declared baselines - a strong configured always-LLM and an ordinary model committee - and apply the pre-registered exit: paired 95% lower bound > 0.05 against every baseline, no added critical errors or gate violations, no geometry worse on average, gain on at least two geometries, cost and p95 latency within 1.25x plus slack.
tier_note: The seed is built and tested; its performance thesis is unverified until the minimum experiment runs. Later stages (Composer, Developmental Cortex, Polyintelligent GREG) are EXPERIMENTAL; frontier capability discovery is FRONTIER; substrate-plural, poly-embodied GREG is SCIENCE-FICTION.
